attchmntText: Paras Defence And Space Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 03, 2025, titled "Paras Defence signs landmark MoU with Israel s MicroCon, brings advanced drone camera technology to India".
sm_name: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited

attchmntText: We are pleased to inform you that Paras Defence And Space Technologies Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with MicroCon Vision Ltd., part of CONTROP and the Rafael Group, Israel for working together in the Micro ISR payloads.
sm_name: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited

attchmntText: Paras Defence And Space Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about proposed divestment of equity in Ayatti Innovative Private Limited (Subsidiary).
sm_name: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited

attchmntText: Paras Defence And Space Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about 100% sale of stake in its wholly owned subsidiary viz. Paras Green UAV Private Limited.
sm_name: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited

attchmntText: Paras Defence And Space Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
